description: Find the earliest time on 2026-03-12 at which `ana`, `ben` and `chi` are all free for a 45-minute meeting that lies entirely within working hours 09:00 to 17:00. Busy blocks are half-open intervals [start, end) in minutes since midnight; they may overlap, may be unsorted, and may extend outside working hours. A meeting may start at the exact minute a block ends and may end at the exact minute a block starts. The meeting may start at any minute. Return the start time as a string `HH:MM` (24-hour, zero-padded), or null if there is no such time.

capabilities.description: Lists a user's busy blocks on a day (YYYY-MM-DD) as minutes since midnight.
